full_text:
Breaker Cub is a Meso-Titan and a smaller "teen" version of the powerful Breaker Titans. Like Breaker, it has the appearance of a four-armed bear with traditional tribal armor and markings decorating its body.

== History ==
Zhalia Moon once encountered a Breaker Cub Titan along with a larger Breaker Titan. She acknowledged its cuteness but noted she would still need to defeat it. [TCG:OAL-053]

== Abilities ==
Although its small size makes the Breaker Cub considerably weaker than its Titan elder, it still possesses many of the facets that make Breaker so dangerous, in particular its sharp claws and teeth.

== Gallery ==

Breaker Icon.jpg|Breaker Cub's Icon
Breaker Cub.png|Breaker Cub

== Trivia ==
*Breaker Cub is referred to as a "Teen Titan" on its TCG card, a reference to the team of teenaged superheroes in the DC Comics known as the Teen Titans. [TCG:OAL-053].
